schema.description: A `CredentialSchema` hit snippet: the [TG-FCT-6a] core plus the [TG-FCT-6b] CredentialSchema-surface groups selected by the projection (default set: `schema`, `ecosystem`). Not DID-bound: no `didCard`. An unselected group is omitted entirely, never `null`.

lastObservedAtTime.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC.
lastObservedAtTime.title: search_response_Iso8601DateTime

title.description: `title` of the loaded body; `null` when the body declares none.

description.description: `description` of the loaded body; `null` when the body declares none.

ecosystem.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `ecosystem` group — the owning Ecosystem (exactly one, per [TG-EDGE-3]). Present iff selected (default set).

propertyNames.description: Participant role per the `Participant` entity table.
propertyNames.title: search_response_ParticipantRole

body.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `body` group — the full loaded JSON Schema body, verbatim; never `null` ([TG-DEREF-2] loads and digest-validates the body before the record exists). Present iff selected (opt-in, wire weight).

schema.title: search_response_CredentialSchemaSnippet
